verses.text: Swik'chaanh Jehová t'a masanil tiempo, swalnhej wach' lolonel t'ay.
Ha t'ay stzalaj in k'ool. Ab'ek ex anima emnakil, tzalajanhek.
Alekel yab'ixal sb'inajnakil Jehová wet'ok, junnhej skutej kik'anek chaanh.
Ix in awaj t'a Jehová, ix tak'wi t'ayin, ix yik'kanel masanil in xiwk'olal.
Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch Jehová yipok sk'ool, stzetzon sat heb' yuj tzalajk'olal, malaj b'aj sk'ixwi heb'.
Ix wal in b'a t'a Jehová, wach'chom te malaj welk'ochi, haxo ix ab'ani, ix in skolanel t'a masanil wilk'olal.
Ha heb' ay yelk'och Jehová t'a sat, a yángel tzoymaj t'a spatik yichanh heb', haxo skolchaj heb' chi' yuj.
Ak'lejek heyila', ol heyilani to te ay swach'k'olal Jehová. Te wach' yik heb' skol sb'a t'a Jehová chi'.
Mach ex yikex Jehová, ayokab' yelk'och t'a he sat. Malaj tas ol yak' palta t'a heb' ay yelk'och Dios t'ay.
Ha nok' choj, tz'el yip nok' yuj wejel, haxo pax heb' syak'em sb'a t'a Jehová, malaj b'ak'inh ol yak' palta junok tas wach' t'a heb'.
Ex unin, kotanhek, ab'ek tas swala', ol ex in k'ayb'ej yik tzeyak'och he pensar t'a Jehová.
Tato syal he k'ol snajatb'i he k 'inal, he gana pax tzalajk'olal tzek' junjun k'u eyuuj,
manhxo eyal chukal lolonel, manhxo eyesej.
Ik'ekel he b'a t'a chukal, manhxo eyak' owal, haxo wach'il tze k'ulej, tze b'eyb'alan junk'olal.
Ha Jehová stanhwan heb' anima wach' sb'eyb'al, smaklan wal yab'i ayik syalan sb'a heb' t'ay.
Ha Jehová, aykot yowal sk'ol t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal yik satel heb', yik manhxa mach ol naan heb'.
Syab' Jehová ayik syalan sb'a heb' anima wach' spensar t'ay, skolchajkanel heb' t'a masanil yilk'olal.
Ha Jehová ayek' t'a stz'ey heb' anima manhxo animaok yet'nak syab'i, skolankanel heb' somchajel sk'ool yuj kuselal.
Ha heb' anima wach' spensar, wach'chom tzijtum tas tz'ik'an heb', haxo Jehová skolanel heb' t'a masanil juntzanh syaelal chi'.
A' stanhwan heb', malaj junok sb'akil heb' ol k'ichajok.
Haxo pax heb' sk'ulan chukal jun, a yuj schukal heb' chi' ol chamok. Ha heb' schichon sk'ol t'a heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, ol kotkan t'a yib'anh heb'.
Haxo Jehová ol kolan heb' schekab'. Ha heb' skol sb'a t'ay, manh ol kotkanlaj t'a yib'anh heb'.
